title: Prakash Enterprises v. Income Tax Department
text: This appeal concerns the assessment order passed under Section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act disallowing export incentive deduction claimed by the assessee. The Commissioner of Income Tax held that the assessee failed to maintain separate accounts for export business and domestic business, disentitling it from claiming deduction under the relevant provision. The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal held in favour of the assessee. The High Court examined Section 80C and the relevant deduction provision. The requirement of maintaining separate accounts is directory and not mandatory. The Commissioner of Income Tax cannot deny a legitimately earned deduction on a technical ground. The assessment order is set aside in relation to the disallowance. The deduction is allowed. The Commissioner of Income Tax's appeal is dismissed.
